cases.translation: I praise the Lord with all my heart.

cases.translation: In the council of the righteous and in the assembly.
cases.explain: The genitive case describes the group being referenced.

cases.sentence: Велики дела ___, желанны всеми, кто любит их.
cases.translation: Great are the works of the Lord, desired by all who delight in them.
He provides food for those who fear him.

Direct object of помнит takes the accusative case.

cases.translation: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.
cases.explain: The preposition перед (before) governs the instrumental case.
